learning_outcomes.text: Knows the concept of fluid and general terminology related to fluids.
Understands the behavior of fluid in a static state.

Learns how to apply Bernoulli's law to fluids. Can establish the relationship between fluid and energy. Develops equations describing fluid flow in both integral and differential forms, and solves simple flow problems.

syllabus_topics: Introduction and Basic Concepts, Properties of Fluids
Reynolds Transport Theorem (RTT) and Law of Conservation of Mass
General Energy and Bernoulli Equations Applications
General Energy and Bernoulli Equations Applications
Linear Momentum Analysis of Flow Systems
Angular Momentum Analysis of Flow Systems
bibliography: Engin, T. (Translation Editor) Fluid Mechanics: Fundamentals and Applications, 3rd. Edition, PALME Publishing House, 2014.
Munson, B.R., Young, D.F., Okiishi, T.H., Fundamentals of Fluid Mechanics, 5th. Ed. John Wiley Sons, Inc.2005
